newsitem.title: UK: Main North Sea crude liftings down 60kbpd in April.
newsitem.headline: Main North Sea crude liftings down 60kbpd in April.

text.p: Daily crude oil loadings from the North Sea's eight main export systems will fall by 60,000 barrels per day (bpd) in April, schedules released recently show.
April liftings under the programmes would average 4.76 million bpd, down from 4.82 million in March.
Schedules for April liftings from Britain's Brent, Forties, and Flotta and Norway's Ekofisk, Gullfaks, Oseberg, Statfjord and Troll detail 143 million barrels in 243.2 cargoes.
Loadings in March were expected to total 149.5 million barrels in 255.8 cargoes.
